Title: Invalid Service Name in Auto-Fill Dropdown Does Not Show "No Records Found" Message or Clear (X) Button
Description: The Service field is an auto-fill/searchable dropdown. Additionally, a Clear (X) button is not displayed to allow users to easily remove the invalid input

CustomFields.Bug - Title: Invalid Service Name in Auto-Fill Dropdown Does Not Show "No Records Found" Message or Clear (X) Button
CustomFields.Description: The Service field is an auto-fill/searchable dropdown. When a user enters an invalid service name that does not match any existing records, the system does not display a "No Records Found" message. Additionally, a Clear (X) button is not displayed to allow users to easily remove the invalid input
CustomFields.Steps to Reproduce:
1.Navigate to Add New Memo.
2.In the Service auto-fill dropdown, enter an invalid value (e.g., SHGWEHJFJF).
3.Observe the dropdown behavior.
CustomFields.Actual Result:
A "No Records Found" message should be displayed when the entered text does not match any service record.
A Clear (X) button should appear, allowing the user to quickly clear the invalid input.

No "No Records Found" message is displayed.
No Clear (X) button is available to remove the invalid text.
The invalid value remains in the field without any indication that no matching record exists.

Title: Supplier Notes date fields have no validation, Supplier Notes do not persist, and Product Of The Day notes are restricted in Edit Service Job
Description: Supplier Notes date fields have no validation, Supplier Notes do not persist, and Product Of The Day notes are restricted in Edit Service Job

CustomFields.Bug - Title: Supplier Notes date fields have no validation, Supplier Notes do not persist, and Product Of The Day notes are restricted in Edit Service Job
CustomFields.Description: Supplier Notes date fields have no validation, Supplier Notes do not persist, and Product Of The Day notes are restricted in Edit Service Job
CustomFields.Steps to Reproduce:
Log in to RingNet and go to Services > Service Jobs.
Open an existing job (e.g., JO1281, demander Ella Carter, supplier Adam) to open Edit Service Job.
In the Supplier Notes section, enter invalid text in both date fields (e.g., 4353454543 and 56wrwefewf).
Enter text in the Supplier Notes text area (e.g., gdfgdfggdfgdfggdfgdfggdfgdfggdf).
Try to enter text in the Product Of The Day notes box.
Save the job, then close and reopen it.
CustomFields.Actual Result:
1.No date validation: Both date fields accept numbers, alphabets and random text, with no error message or field highlight.            
2.Supplier Notes not persisting: After saving and reopening the job, the Supplier Notes (and dates) are blank or not retained.                   
3.Product Of The Day restricted: The notes box ("Product of the day notes...") does not accept input as expected.
CustomFields.Expected Result:
1.The date fields should accept only valid dates in the application format, show an error such as "Please enter a valid date" for invalid input, and not allow saving with invalid dates. The From date should not be later than the To date, if both are used.
2.Supplier Notes and their dates should be saved with the job and shown correctly when it is reopened.
3.The Product Of The Day notes should be editable, and the text should be saved, according to the user's permissions.
